political_parties_details.core_ideology_and_manifesto: Social justice, Dravidian nationalism, state autonomy, rationalism, and a two-language policy. The party heavily focuses on state rights, welfare schemes, and opposing the imposition of Hindi.
political_parties_details.relevant_details: It is one of the two major political forces in Tamil Nadu. The party split from the Dravidar Kazhagam headed by Periyar E. V. Ramasamy.

political_parties_details.party_name: All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam
political_parties_details.core_ideology_and_manifesto: Dravidianism, social justice, welfarism, and populism. The party is known for implementing massive public welfare programs and subsidies (such as the Amma Canteens and free laptops for students).
political_parties_details.relevant_details: Formed as a breakaway faction from the DMK, it is the other major political force in Tamil Nadu. It saw massive expansion under the leadership of M.G. Ramachandran and later J. Jayalalithaa.

political_parties_details.core_ideology_and_manifesto: Secular social justice, egalitarianism, two-language policy, and a corruption-free, transparent administration. Their core slogan is 'All are equal by birth'.
political_parties_details.relevant_details: A newly formed party by popular actor Vijay that actively positions itself against both religious sectarianism and political corruption. It has positioned itself as a centre-left alternative in the 2026 assembly elections.

political_parties_details.core_ideology_and_manifesto: Tamil nationalism, environmentalism, and anti-corruption. Their recent manifesto emphasizes decentralized governance (proposing multiple capitals for Tamil Nadu), anti-drug measures, and policies centered on agriculture and Tamil identity.
political_parties_details.relevant_details: The party considers itself a revival of S. P. Adithanar's 'We Tamils' movement. It is known for contesting elections independently without alliances and consistently allocating 50% of its seats to women candidates.

political_parties_details.core_ideology_and_manifesto: Social democracy, populism, and advocacy for backward class rights. Originally emerged to demand Most Backward Caste (MBC) status and political representation for the Vanniyar community.
political_parties_details.relevant_details: The party grew out of the Vanniyar Sangam movement. Recently in 2025/2026, the party has experienced internal leadership disputes between founder S. Ramadoss and his son Anbumani Ramadoss.

political_parties_details.core_ideology_and_manifesto: Anti-casteism, Dalit rights, social equality, and Tamil nationalism. The party strongly advocates for the annihilation of the caste system and the protection of marginalized communities.
political_parties_details.relevant_details: Originally the Dalit Panthers of India (DPI), it is a major political voice for the Scheduled Castes in Tamil Nadu.

political_parties_details.founder: Syama Prasad Mukherjee (BJS precursor); Atal Bihari Vajpayee, L. K. Advani
political_parties_details.core_ideology_and_manifesto: Cultural nationalism, Hindutva, conservatism, and integral humanism. In Tamil Nadu, the party focuses on national integration, spiritual heritage, and central government welfare schemes.
political_parties_details.relevant_details: While a dominant national party, it has historically operated as a smaller player in Tamil Nadu, aiming to build a third front alternative to the Dravidian majors.

political_parties_details.party_name: Indian National Congress (Tamil Nadu Congress Committee)
political_parties_details.core_ideology_and_manifesto: Centrism, secularism, social democracy, and liberal nationalism. Focuses on inclusive growth, welfare, and protecting constitutional values.
political_parties_details.relevant_details: The TNCC governed Tamil Nadu continuously after independence until 1967. Since then, it has primarily contested elections in alliance with either the DMK or AIADMK.

political_parties_details.core_ideology_and_manifesto: Centrism, anti-corruption, and welfarism. The party aims to provide a clean, corruption-free alternative to the established Dravidian parties.
political_parties_details.relevant_details: Founded by the late actor Vijayakanth, the party peaked as the principal opposition party in the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly in 2011.

political_parties_details.core_ideology_and_manifesto: Dravidianism, state autonomy, and peaceful resolution of the Tamil Eelam issue. Strongly opposes the privatization of public sectors and advocates for state-level independence on policy matters.
political_parties_details.relevant_details: Formed after Vaiko was expelled from the DMK. The party is known for its strong ideological stances and oratorical campaigns.

political_parties_details.core_ideology_and_manifesto: Centrism, rationalism, and anti-corruption. Focuses on improving rural infrastructure, digitization of government services, and environmental protection.
political_parties_details.relevant_details: Founded by actor Kamal Haasan, the party focuses heavily on urban governance and educated voter demographics.

political_parties_details.core_ideology_and_manifesto: Dravidianism and welfarism. Primarily aims to reclaim and continue the political legacy of late AIADMK leader J. Jayalalithaa.
political_parties_details.relevant_details: Emerged as a breakaway faction from the AIADMK following the death of J. Jayalalithaa and subsequent internal leadership struggles.

political_parties_details.founder: E. M. S. Namboodiripad, Jyoti Basu (among others)
political_parties_details.core_ideology_and_manifesto: Marxism-Leninism, communism, and anti-capitalism. Focuses on the rights of the working class, trade unionism, and land reforms.
political_parties_details.relevant_details: A national party that split from the CPI in 1964. It has a dedicated cadre base in Tamil Nadu, particularly among industrial and agricultural workers.

political_parties_details.founder: M. N. Roy, Abani Mukherji (among others)
political_parties_details.core_ideology_and_manifesto: Marxism-Leninism, socialism. Advocates for secularism, democratic rights, and economic equality.
political_parties_details.relevant_details: One of the oldest political parties in India, maintaining a presence in Tamil Nadu through historical trade union movements and alliances.
